objectif: Create and configure a company (assisted setup, company information, number series)
Manage security (users, user groups, permission sets, entitlements)
Set up core app functionality (email, document layouts, job queue, role centers and profiles)
Set up dimensions (dimensions, dimension values, default dimensions, dimension combinations)
Migrate data (configuration packages, configuration templates, export and import)
Set up the change log and audit trails
Set up finance (chart of accounts, G/L account categories, accounting periods, journal templates and batches)
Set up posting groups (general posting setup, business and product posting groups, specific posting groups)
Set up currencies (exchange rates, additional reporting currency, exchange rate adjustment)
Set up accounts receivable (payment terms and methods, customer posting groups, reminders and finance charges)
Set up accounts payable (payment terms, vendor posting groups, payment discounts)
Set up VAT (VAT business and product posting groups, VAT posting setup, VAT statements, VAT reporting)
Set up cash management (bank accounts, bank account reconciliation, payment journals)
Set up fixed assets (fixed asset cards, depreciation books, FA posting groups)
Set up financial reporting (financial reports / account schedules, analysis by dimensions)
Set up inventory (item cards, item categories, units of measure, costing methods, locations)
Configure sales (customer cards, price lists, line and invoice discounts, salespeople, shipping agents)
Configure purchasing (vendor cards, purchase prices and discounts, purchasers, purchases and payables setup)
Perform basic tasks (search, filters, personalization, notes and links, Excel/Word/Outlook integration)
Purchase items (quotes, orders, receipts, invoices, returns, credit memos, item charges, drop shipment)
Sell items (quotes, orders, shipments, invoices, blanket orders, returns, credit memos)
Process financial transactions (journals, applying entries, payments, reversals, recurring journals, deferrals)
Perform inventory operations (item journals, physical inventory, transfer orders, adjust cost, reordering policies)
Set up and use jobs (job cards, resources, time sheets, job planning lines, WIP)
Set up and use approval workflows (approval user setup, approval hierarchies, workflow templates)
